units.source_text: 这种仪式，太吉郎年轻时就看过多次，并不觉得新奇。

en.t: Taikichiro had seen this sort of ceremony many times when he was young, so he did not find it especially novel.

units.source_text: 不过，他想带千重子去看看。

en.t: Still, he wanted to take Chieko to see it.

units.source_text: 何况据说今年因经费关系，鞍马寺十月间的火节也不举行了。

en.t: Besides, it was said that this year, because of funding problems, the fire festival at Kurama Temple in October would not be held either.
